nodes.label: Architecture: System Overview
nodes.description: C4 Level 1 and Level 2 diagrams, actor/app matrix, 9 domain modules, tech stack, booking lifecycle data flow, security/auth, external integrations (payment gateway, Cloudinary), and key architectural decisions. Last updated 2026-05-16.

nodes.label: Architecture: Booking & Session
nodes.description: Planned vs Actual separation principle: Booking=contract, Session=operations. Entity map, Booking state machine (PENDING→CONFIRMED→COMPLETED/CANCELLED/NO_SHOW), Session state machine (CHECKED_IN→ACTIVE→EXTENDING/CHECKING_OUT→COMPLETED), timeout rules, SessionVehicle vehicle-swap support, booking modes (RENTAL/BYOC/MIXED). Last updated 2026-05-17.

nodes.label: Booking Data Flow Diagram
nodes.description: Tables touched per step across two phases: Phase 1 (booking creation and payment — bookings, booking_participants, booking_vehicles, fnb_orders, payment_components, payment_transactions) and Phase 2 (session lifecycle — sessions, session_vehicles, inspections, inspection_photos, incidents, disputes, trust_score_logs, reviews). Happy-path and unhappy-case flows documented.

nodes.label: Backend Schema Index
nodes.description: Quick-reference index of 26 database tables grouped by domain: USER & AUTH (users, refresh_tokens, password_reset_tokens), CAFE (cafes, cafe_images, cafe_closures, cafe_announcements), STAFF (staff_cafe_assignments), FLEET (vehicles, vehicle_images, vehicle_maintenance_logs), BOOKING (bookings, inspection_records, extension_proposals, disputes), PAYMENT (payment_components, payment_transactions), PROMOTIONS (promotions, promotion_usages), F&B (menu_items, fnb_orders, fnb_order_items), REVIEWS & NOTIFICATIONS (reviews, notification_logs), SYSTEM (feature_flags, trust_score_logs). All enums defined.

nodes.label: Backend README
nodes.description: RCField backend setup guide: Node.js 22+, Express.js, PostgreSQL 16 via TypeORM, Redis 7, Zod validation, JWT auth, Cloudinary, Docker Compose. Scripts for dev/build/migration/test. 26 tables, 4 roles, test infrastructure with separate rcfeild_test DB.

nodes.label: Backend Docker Compose
nodes.description: Docker Compose config spinning up PostgreSQL 16 (port 5432, container rcfeild_postgres, DB rcfeild_db) and Redis 7 (port 6379, container rcfeild_redis) with persistent volumes and healthchecks.

nodes.label: Backend CLAUDE.md — Coding Guidelines
nodes.description: AI coding guidelines for the backend: controller convention (endpoint comment above every handler), logger convention (no console.log, use logger from src/config/logger.ts), validation convention (all Zod schemas in src/validate/index.ts grouped by table), enum convention (all enums in src/types/index.ts), and naming convention table.

nodes.label: ERD Core Preview
nodes.description: Entity-relationship diagram showing core entities. Visible relationships include: User (blue) owns Cafe (green, center), User 1:N makes Booking (green, center), User 1:N at Cafe, Cafe 0:1:N Booking, Booking 1:N to payment/inspection related table (orange, right with FK/confirm columns), Booking 1:N to session_vehicles or similar (blue, bottom-left), Booking 1:N to another table (yellow, bottom-center), Booking 1:0..1 to dispute (pink, bottom-right). Text is small and partially unreadable in image.

nodes.label: RCField Platform
nodes.description: B2B SaaS for RC car track chain operator in Vietnam. One provider, multiple branches, shared system. Not a marketplace. Core value: structured digital evidence at every asset handover to eliminate damage disputes.

nodes.label: Actor: Customer
nodes.description: Customer role: books slots, pre-orders F&B, makes payments, confirms check-in/out, opens disputes. Uses mobile-first web app. Has trust_score (0-100, default 100) affecting RESTRICTED tier rental eligibility.

nodes.label: Actor: Staff
nodes.description: Staff role: performs check-in/out, records F&B orders, proposes extensions, uploads inspection photos. Uses mobile-first web app. Assigned to one cafe per staff_cafe_assignments.

nodes.label: Actor: Provider
nodes.description: Provider role: manages all branches (cafes), fleet, F&B menus, views revenue. Uses desktop/tablet web app. Sees aggregate totals plus drill-down per branch.

nodes.label: Actor: Admin
nodes.description: Admin role: team RCField (the software vendor). Approves cafes, monitors incident policy, manages feature flags, adjudicates formal disputes. Uses desktop admin portal.

nodes.label: Web App (Frontend)
nodes.description: ReactJS + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS SPA. Mobile-first. Role-based UI routing from JWT UserRole. All 4 actors share one app. Server state via React Query, client state via Zustand, HTTP via Axios. Vietnamese UI.

nodes.label: API Server (Backend)
nodes.description: Node.js 20+/22 + Express.js REST API. TypeScript strict mode. Router-per-domain architecture: auth, bookings, sessions, inspections, incidents, payments, fleet, F&B. Middleware stack: logger → CORS → JWT → RBAC. Validation via Zod. Business logic in service layer.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Database
nodes.description: PostgreSQL 16 accessed via TypeORM. 26 operational tables (Phase 1). All monetary values NUMERIC(15,2). UUID PKs. Soft delete on users, vehicles, menu_items. bookings.snapshot (jsonb) is the sole source for payment calculations.

nodes.label: Redis Cache / Lock
nodes.description: Redis 7 used for slot locking. Redis key pattern: slot:rental:{cafeId}:{vehicleId}:{date}:{slotStart} (SET NX, TTL 1800s). Also used for session/job queue.

nodes.label: Cloudinary (Photo Storage)
nodes.description: External service for storing inspection photos. Path convention: inspections/{booking_id}/{check_in|check_out}/{angle}.jpg. 4 mandatory angles: front, back, left, right. Upload before writing DB — reject full inspection request if upload fails. URL stored in DB.

nodes.label: Payment Gateway (TBD)
nodes.description: External payment processor, provider not yet finalized (VNPay / MoMo / VietQR). Handles booking + F&B pre-order payment in one transaction. Server-side signature verification required. Interface abstracted for easy swap.

nodes.label: Scheduler / Cron Jobs
nodes.description: Node.js cron jobs enforcing timeout rules: PENDING booking 30m auto-cancel, no-show 30m after slot_start, check-in auto-confirm 15m, extension auto-reject 10m, checkout auto-confirm 2h (no damage) or 24h (damage).

nodes.label: Module: Auth
nodes.description: Auth domain module at /auth. JWT access token (15m) + refresh token (7d). RBAC with 4 roles. Endpoints: register, login, refresh, me. All enums in src/types/index.ts, all Zod schemas in src/validate/index.ts.

nodes.label: Module: Booking
nodes.description: Booking domain module at /bookings. Manages booking lifecycle and state machine. State transitions must go through BookingService.transition(). Supports RENTAL, BYOC, MIXED modes.

nodes.label: Module: Payment
nodes.description: Internal payment service (no direct router). Component-based immutable ledger. Types: SLOT_FEE, RENTAL_FEE, SECURITY_DEPOSIT, EXTENSION_FEE, DAMAGE_CHARGE, FB_PREORDER. Platform fee 15% on consummated components disbursed to Provider (0% on F&B). Settlement per session.

nodes.label: Module: Fleet
nodes.description: Fleet domain module at /cafes/:id/vehicles. Vehicle CRUD, tier (STANDARD/PREMIUM/RESTRICTED), status management. Vehicle has hourly_rate, security_deposit, damage_multiplier, compatible_track_types.

nodes.label: Module: Inspection
nodes.description: Inspection domain module at /bookings/:id/inspections. Check-in/out protocol with 4-angle photo upload to Cloudinary + checklist. Evidence chain: inspections → inspection_photos → inspection_checklists. Missing photos/checklist = Provider loses right to charge DAMAGE_CHARGE.

nodes.label: Module: Extension
nodes.description: Extension domain module at /sessions/:id/extensions. Staff proposes extra time, Customer approves/rejects. 10-minute auto-reject timeout. Fee is post-paid, charged against deposit (max 50%).

nodes.label: Module: Incident
nodes.description: Incident domain module at /incidents. Policy-based automated resolution: log responsible_party, final_amount, resolution_note. Phase 1 layer for damage/dispute handling before formal dispute escalation.

nodes.label: Module: F&B
nodes.description: F&B domain module at /cafes/:id/menu and /bookings/:id/fnb-orders. Menu management, pre-order (bundled with booking payment), on-site order (customer pays Provider directly, platform not involved). 0% platform fee on F&B.

nodes.label: Module: Cafe
nodes.description: Cafe discovery module at /cafes. Listing, filtering, branch profile, shareable links (Zalo/FB). Config: track_types, slot_duration_minutes, slot_fee_rate, byoc_capacity. Status: PENDING/ACTIVE/SUSPENDED.

nodes.label: Entity: Booking
nodes.description: Planned booking contract. Columns: customer_id→users, cafe_id→cafes, vehicle_id→vehicles (null for BYOC), mode (RENTAL/BYOC), source (APP/STAFF_MANUAL), track_type, status (PENDING/CONFIRMED/ACTIVE/EXTENDING/CHECKING_OUT/DISPUTED/COMPLETED/CANCELLED), slot_start, slot_end, slot_count, payment_expires_at, snapshot (jsonb — sole source for payment calculations), promotion_id→promotions, discount_amount.

nodes.label: Entity: Session
nodes.description: Actual play session. Created only when Staff checks in. Stores actual_start_at, actual_end_at. A booking can have multiple sessions. Transitions via SessionService.transition(). States: CHECKED_IN, ACTIVE, EXTENDING, CHECKING_OUT, COMPLETED, CANCELLED.

nodes.label: Entity: User
nodes.description: All users across 4 roles. Columns: id (uuid), email, role (CUSTOMER/PROVIDER/STAFF/ADMIN), trust_score, auth_provider (LOCAL/GOOGLE), deleted_at (soft delete).

nodes.label: Entity: Cafe
nodes.description: Branch entity. Columns: provider_id→users, slug (unique), status (PENDING/ACTIVE/SUSPENDED), track_types[], slot_duration_minutes, slot_fee_rate, byoc_capacity.

nodes.label: Entity: Vehicle
nodes.description: Fleet vehicle per branch. Columns: cafe_id→cafes, tier (STANDARD/PREMIUM/RESTRICTED), status (AVAILABLE/IN_USE/MAINTENANCE/RETIRED), hourly_rate, security_deposit, damage_multiplier, compatible_track_types[], deleted_at.

nodes.label: Entity: PaymentComponent
nodes.description: Immutable payment ledger entry. Columns: booking_id→bookings, type (SLOT_FEE/RENTAL_FEE/SECURITY_DEPOSIT/EXTENSION_FEE/DAMAGE_CHARGE/FB_PREORDER), amount (NUMERIC 15,2), status (PENDING/HELD/DISBURSED/REFUNDED/PARTIALLY_REFUNDED), disbursed_to→users. Never update amount — create new component instead.
nodes.rationale: Immutable ledger ensures accurate audit trail and enables partial refund without corrupting historical records.

nodes.label: Entity: PaymentTransaction
nodes.description: Raw payment gateway log. Columns: booking_id→bookings, gateway, gateway_transaction_id, type (PAYMENT/REFUND), raw_request (jsonb), raw_response (jsonb). Separate from component ledger.

nodes.label: Entity: InspectionRecord
nodes.description: Check-in or check-out inspection per booking. Columns: booking_id→bookings, type (CHECK_IN/CHECK_OUT), performed_by→users, photos (jsonb), checklist (jsonb), pre_existing_flag, damage_noted. UNIQUE(booking_id, type).

nodes.label: Entity: ExtensionProposal
nodes.description: Session extension request. Columns: booking_id→bookings, proposed_by→users, duration_minutes, fee_amount, status (PENDING/APPROVED/REJECTED/EXPIRED). 10-minute auto-reject timeout.

nodes.label: Entity: Dispute
nodes.description: Formal dispute per booking (max 1). Columns: booking_id→bookings (UNIQUE), opened_by→users, status (OPEN/UNDER_REVIEW/RESOLVED), resolution_favor (CUSTOMER/PROVIDER), resolved_by→users. Admin (RCField team) adjudicates.

nodes.label: Entity: Promotion
nodes.description: Discount code. Columns: code (UNIQUE when active), discount_type (PERCENT/FIXED), discount_value, max_discount_amount, applicable_to (ALL/RENTAL/BYOC), cafe_id→cafes (NULL=global chain-wide), uses_count, max_uses, max_uses_per_user.

nodes.label: Entity: TrustScoreLog
nodes.description: Immutable customer trust score history. Columns: user_id→users, booking_id→bookings (nullable), delta, score_before, score_after, reason (NO_SHOW/DAMAGE_CONFIRMED/DISPUTE_LOST/BOOKING_STREAK/ADMIN_ADJUSTMENT). Trust score (0-100) affects RESTRICTED tier rental eligibility.

nodes.label: Entity: FnbOrder
nodes.description: F&B order. Types: PRE_ORDER (bundled with booking payment, 0% platform fee) or ON_SITE (customer pays Provider directly, outside platform). Columns: booking_id→bookings, type (PRE_ORDER/ON_SITE), status (PENDING/CONFIRMED/DELIVERED/CANCELLED), created_by→users.

nodes.label: Entity: FeatureFlag
nodes.description: Feature toggle system. Columns: feature_key (UNIQUE), is_enabled, is_trial, trial_ends_at. Managed by ADMIN role.

nodes.label: Booking State Machine
nodes.description: States: PENDING→CONFIRMED (payment success), PENDING→CANCELLED (30m timeout or customer cancel), CONFIRMED→COMPLETED (all sessions done), CONFIRMED→CANCELLED, CONFIRMED→NO_SHOW (slot_start + 30m no check-in). All transitions via BookingService.transition(bookingId, event).

nodes.label: Session State Machine
nodes.description: States: CHECKED_IN→ACTIVE (check-in complete), CHECKED_IN→CANCELLED; ACTIVE→EXTENDING (extension proposed), ACTIVE→CHECKING_OUT; EXTENDING→ACTIVE (approved/rejected/10m timeout); CHECKING_OUT→COMPLETED (customer confirm or auto-confirm 2h/24h). All transitions via SessionService.transition().

nodes.label: Snapshot-First Payment Principle
nodes.description: All payment calculations read from booking.snapshot (jsonb), never from current cafe/vehicle prices. Prices are locked at booking creation time.
nodes.rationale: Vehicle and slot prices can change over time; snapshot ensures correct billing regardless of price changes after booking.

nodes.label: Planned vs Actual Separation
nodes.description: Booking = planned contract (booking_participants, booking_vehicles, slot_start/slot_end). Session = actual operations (session_participants, session_vehicles, actual_start_at/actual_end_at). Session created only when Staff checks in, not at booking time.
nodes.rationale: Separating planned from actual data allows flexible operations (vehicle swaps, participant changes) without corrupting the original booking contract.

nodes.label: Evidence-Based Handover
nodes.description: Digital evidence created at every asset handover: 4-angle photos (front/back/left/right) + checklist at check-in and check-out. Evidence chain: inspections → inspection_photos → inspection_checklists. Missing evidence = Provider forfeits DAMAGE_CHARGE right.
nodes.rationale: Core value proposition: structured evidence eliminates damage disputes by providing objective photographic proof.

nodes.description: Source of truth for entity definitions and enums. Referenced by architecture docs before creating any entity or schema.

nodes.label: Spec: State Machine
nodes.description: Source of truth for full booking and session state machines including all event enums. Must be read before touching booking lifecycle.

nodes.label: Spec: Payment Engine
nodes.description: Source of truth for payment component lifecycle, settlement logic, and refund rules R1/R2/R3. Mandatory before implementing any payment logic.

nodes.label: Spec: Inspection Flow
nodes.description: Source of truth for check-in/out protocol, evidence chain requirements, Cloudinary integration. Read before implementing inspection module.

nodes.label: Spec: API Contracts
nodes.description: Source of truth for all REST API endpoint contracts. Read before creating any new endpoint.

nodes.label: Spec: Database
nodes.description: Detailed schema and SQL for all 26 tables. Full source of truth for database structure.

nodes.label: ADR: Express.js Backend Framework
nodes.description: Architecture decision record for choosing Express.js over alternatives.
nodes.rationale: Team of 4 developers, 4-month timeline — Express is simple enough and safe to deploy quickly.

nodes.label: Backend Logger (src/config/logger.ts)
nodes.description: Custom logger used throughout backend. Methods: logger.auth(), logger.info(), logger.warn(), logger.error(), logger.debug(). console.log is forbidden.

nodes.label: Backend Zod Schemas (src/validate/index.ts)
nodes.description: Centralized Zod validation schemas grouped by table. Controllers import from '../validate'. Schemas never defined inside controllers.

nodes.label: Backend Enums & Types (src/types/index.ts)
nodes.description: Centralized TypeScript enums (BookingStatus, AssetTier, etc.), AppError class, AuthRequest interface. Enums never defined inside entities or services.
